_comment: sim-station-lock-from-preplace-v1: the integration recipe + acceptance for engaging the FULL base brake EARLIER -- at the carried pre-place instead of the place descent. NAMED CAUSE (coldwin68 / coldwin69, datasets .../mission/coldwin68.console.log + coldwin69.console.log): both runs PARKED at exactly the same spot as the no-shove reference coldwin64 ((-4.61, 14.77); the geometry lane sim-place-target-between-posts-v1 measured all three), MOBILE_BRAKE engaged (full-rotation-lock@target D6) [CHASSIS_STATION_PITCH_HOLD] at the park, STATION_PLACE_FULL_BRAKE enabled at assemble. But with the sim-preplace-wrist2-hold-v1 firm wrist hold now STOPPING the wrist giving way (PREPLACE_HOLD_FIRM at the end of pre-place leg 1), the carried pre-place's SECOND leg (shoulder_pan sweep, CARTON_TICK phase=preplace) drove its reaction THROUGH the arm into the base -- and during pre-place only the base ROTATION is held (engage_brake / CHASSIS_STATION_PITCH_HOLD leaves TRANSLATION FREE); the full six-axis lock engaged only once the place descent began (phase 'place'). So over sim t~185-235 the BASE_YAW_TICK base_dxy grew ~330 mm (the shove, t~191->227), and the carton came down ~0.5 m off its cart-relative target onto a cage post. coldwin64 (which still had SOFT wrists) stayed put -- base_dxy < 20 mm through the same window -- because the soft wrist absorbed the leg-2 reaction instead of transmitting it to the base. FIX = engage the full six-axis lock BEFORE the firm-held carried pre-place starts, so the carton lands where it is aimed.
_shipped: An opt-in RUNTIME key station_full_brake_engage_phase that chooses WHEN the sim-station-full-brake-place-v1 full D6 lock engages relative to the carried pre-place. The lock window, the lock primitive (MobileController.engage_station_full_lock), the effort guard and the release at stow/verify are all UNCHANGED -- this key only moves the ENGAGE point earlier. Values: 'place' (DEFAULT == today: engage at the descent, pre-place rotation-only -- byte-identical to before this key); 'preplace' (engage at the START of the carried pre-place, before leg 1, so both legs run under the full lock); 'hold_firm' (engage the moment ANY carried pre-place joint is firmed -- the PREPLACE_HOLD_FIRM hold-firm-on-arrival event, end of leg 1 -- i.e. locked exactly when a joint has arrived and before the leg-2 sweep). One engage at the chosen trigger, one release at withdraw -- no cycling (idempotent re-engage). The port owns the phase->engage decision via the pure predicate station_full_brake.full_lock_window; the MobileController carries the resolved value only so the port can read it off the controller like station_place_full_brake.
_recommended_trigger: preplace. The captain's cause says 'the base must be fully locked BEFORE the firm-held carried pre-place starts' -- 'preplace' locks before leg 1, covering the WHOLE pre-place (both legs) with no gap, and it needs no extra config. The carton is AIRBORNE through the entire pre-place, so the weld-loop concern that made the descent-time brake leave translation free (run-208/209) does NOT apply until contact at 'place' -- a full lock through pre-place cannot over-constrain a weld loop that does not exist yet. 'hold_firm' is offered as the cleaner-trigger ALTERNATIVE: it ties the lock to the actual firm event (end of leg 1) instead of a phase boundary, so it locks a little later but exactly when a joint has settled; use it only if a future design wants the base translation-free through leg 1. 'hold_firm' REQUIRES phase_drive.hold_firm_on_arrival.enabled (config_preflight enforces this) or its trigger never fires and it silently falls back to 'place'.
_weld_loop_safety: Extending the lock backward into pre-place does NOT widen the weld-loop fight: the carton is airborne through pre-place (no world->base->arm->weld->carton->support loop closes until the descent meets the support at 'place'), so the loop-closure window -- and hence the effort guard's job -- is EXACTLY as before (contact at 'place' -> PLACE_CONTACT_RELEASE opens it immediately; station_place_full_brake_effort_limit HOLDs, never shoves, on a sustained over-limit spike). The effort guard's IN-WINDOW predicate now follows the same full_lock_window, so STATION_FULL_BRAKE_EFFORT logging covers the extended window too (no effort expected over pre-place; the carton is in the air).
_integration_lane_steps: 1. Start from the coldwin68/69 mission RUNTIME config (it already has chassis_station_pitch_hold: true, station_place_full_brake: true, collect_place_base_settle_m: 0.08, the sim-preplace-wrist2-hold phase_drive hold-firm block, and the between-posts place target). Keep ALL of it. Copy to your own dir -- do NOT hand-edit the integration lane's ~/datasets configs.
2. Add the one RUNTIME key station_full_brake_engage_phase below (top-level; physics_setup.assemble reads it into the MobileController).

3. config_preflight: scripts/twin/restock_manipulation/config_preflight.py --runtime-config <your runtime.json> [...]. check_station_full_brake REFUSES the key without station_place_full_brake / chassis_station_pitch_hold, refuses an unknown value, and refuses 'hold_firm' without phase_drive.hold_firm_on_arrival.enabled. Expect CONFIG_PREFLIGHT: PASS.

4. Run the bounded between-posts collect proof (the coldwin68/69 cycle) as the next coldwin, serialized through /tmp/aile-gpu.lock, HEAVY_MB=2500 if whispr holds VRAM, renice +10, never --force. This lane proves on CPU; the GPU belongs to the integration lane.

5. In the log confirm: 'STATION_PLACE_FULL_BRAKE enabled ... [engage_phase=preplace]' at assemble; ONE 'MOBILE_BRAKE engaged (full-D6 lock ... from phase=preplace)' at the START of pre-place (for 'preplace') or 'from phase=preplace' at the PREPLACE_HOLD_FIRM tick (for 'hold_firm') and ONE 'MOBILE_BRAKE released (full-D6 lock)' at withdraw -- not cycling; BASE_YAW_TICK base_dxy staying small (< ~20 mm) through pre-place AND place/release/retreat (coldwin68/69 was ~330 mm over pre-place); the carton landing ON its cart-relative target (not ~0.5 m off onto a cage post); verify_place passing; CARTON_TILT <= the unchanged 2.0 deg bound.

runtime_config_keys._note: The FULL set to enable the earlier engage. The first four are the EXISTING sim-station-full-brake-place-v1 keys (keep them). station_full_brake_engage_phase is the ONE new key. 'preplace' is recommended; switch to 'hold_firm' only with the phase_drive.hold_firm_on_arrival block present (which the coldwin68/69 config already carries). station_place_full_brake_effort_limit stays whatever the run already used.

_acceptance_next_coldwin.base_drift_during_preplace_m: <= 0.02 (the measured base xy excursion over the WHOLE carried pre-place AND place/release/retreat; coldwin68/69 was ~0.33 m over pre-place under the rotation-only hold)
_acceptance_next_coldwin.carton_lands_on_target: the carton set-down x/y matches its cart-relative target (not ~0.5 m off onto a cage post as in coldwin68/69)
_acceptance_next_coldwin.one_engage_one_release: exactly one 'MOBILE_BRAKE engaged (full-D6 lock ... from phase=preplace)' and one 'MOBILE_BRAKE released (full-D6 lock)' -- no cycling across the pre-place->place->release->retreat span
_acceptance_next_coldwin.verify_place: passes with the carton resting on its destination (not off-target, not fallen)
_acceptance_next_coldwin.carton_tilt_peak_deg: <= 2.0 (the captain's bound, unchanged by this lane)
_acceptance_next_coldwin.run_advances_past_collect: the mission proceeds to couple/outbound instead of the off-target place / stuck collect

_cpu_proof: scripts/twin/tests/test_station_full_brake.py (resolve_engage_phase default/validation; full_lock_window for place/preplace/hold_firm incl. the collect-only scope; the engage-phase brake state machine on a mock mobile for the coldwin68 pre-place timeline -- 'preplace' locks before leg 1 at base_dxy 0.000, 'hold_firm' locks at the firm event before the leg-2 sweep (base still under 0.080), 'place' only locks at the descent AFTER the ~0.33 m shove, each one engage / no cycling; the _apply_hold_firm latch arms on the firm event and clears on leaving pre-place; config_preflight validation incl. the dangling-key, unknown-value and hold_firm-needs-config refusals; default/off byte-identical). The existing sim-station-full-brake-place-v1 and sim-preplace-wrist2-hold-v1 suites stay green.
_out_of_scope: The place SPOT (sim-place-target-between-posts-v1 / another lane), the release mechanism (place_contact_release), the perception lanes, the 2.0 deg carton-level bound. GPU runs (never take /tmp/aile-gpu.lock). Delete nothing under ~/datasets.
